attr.title: Dr. Robotnik's Ring Racers
attr.desc: Kart racer based on SRB2 (v2.4). Native OpenGL ES 2.0 build for the R36S / dArkOS. Game data (.pk3) not included.
attr.inst: Copy RingRacers.sh and the ringracers folder to /roms/ports. Put the game .pk3 files inside ringracers/ (see fetch-assets.sh). Launch from Ports.
